anita-people: FYI — offer ready for EM, infra (Omar). Comp band is above guideline and candidate is asking for a 5% signing to cover relocation. Need comp exception + finance sign-off + benefits check for a UK bank-holiday start. Hiring mgr: @sam-eng. Can we route?

sam-eng: Yep. Can you add a short comp rationale + market comps? I'll sign off once comp committee + finance ok.

mohit-recruiting: Re: timing — candidate is aiming to start 2026-04-07 (Good Friday, UK). Do we usually set start on a bank holiday or next business day? Any payroll implications?

anita-people: Added comp rationale doc here: https://redwood.internal/docs/comp/OMAR-2026 (market comps + leveling note). Also draft offer attached. Thoughts on start date?

jill-benefits: Jill: Benefits note — new hires become eligible on their start date but enrollment processing is done on next payroll cycle. If start is on a bank holiday, there's no technical blocker but admin will process on next business day. Recommendation: set start to 2026-04-08 to avoid confusion with payroll/relocation timing.

rory-finance: Rory-Finance: Finance needs a cost-impact calc and GL charge. Also needs confirmation whether the signing bonus is one-time or split. Please route to finance-approvals or add me.

anita-people: Headcount code ENG2026-OPS-14. I just routed the exception to finance and submitted comp request to comp committee. @comp-committee-bot any ETA? Also tagging @legal-bot for right-to-work timing.

comp-committee-bot: New exception request received: ID CC-2026-042. Members assigned: Priya, Marco, Lena. Proposed quick review slot: 2026-03-30 10:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.internal/comp-committee/CC-2026-042

priya: Priya: I can review. If the market comps support this, I can approve conditionally. Please include candidate's last compensation + relocation ask + recruiter notes.

marco: Marco: I need to see comp comps vs. band midpoint and a short note on promotion trajectory. Also prefer offer to start on 4/8 as benefits suggested.

anita-people: Uploaded recruiter notes and last comp. Promotion path added to the doc. Recruiter notes: strong infra infra ops background, referral, immediate project impact. Proposed terms (draft):
```
Base: £145,000
Signing: 5% one-time = £7,250 (subject to finance)
Equity: 3-year standard grant
Start date: 2026-04-08 (per benefits rec)
```

sam-eng: I'm good to approve once comp committee + finance are green. Sam-ENG: +1 on 4/8 start.

rory-finance: Finance provisional ok for one-time signing, but need GL code and payment timing. I'll add GL: 700-ENG-REC and confirm payment schedule in the ticket.

jill-benefits: I'll update the benefits enrollment playbook for this hire with 4/8 start and note expected admin lag until payroll run. Also confirm relocation stipend can be backdated to start if finance approves.

anita-people: Great — I'll update the offer letter to 2026-04-08 and mark the signing conditional on finance approval. Thanks y'all. :thumbsup:

legal-bot: Legal check queued — ensure RTW docs collected before start; automated reminder will fire 7 days prior to start.

anita-people: Filing this as CC-2026-042 in tracker. Will post outcome once comp committee votes. Thanks everyone for the quick responses.
